query:
SELECT DISTINCT
                COALESCE(t.parent_task_id, t.id) AS "task_id!",
                l.equipment_id,
                eq.hourly_rate_cents
            FROM task_equipment_links l
            JOIN tasks t ON t.id = l.task_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
            JOIN equipment eq ON eq.id = l.equipment_id
            WHERE t.org_id = $1
